text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Dants! We're throwing your birthday 
party at Tachyon and Cafe's hideout, so 
come on over!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Heh, thanks... Wait, WHAAAT?! Those two's 
secret base... is the old science prep 
room?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh. When I asked to borrow the room, they 
said yes right away, and they were 
actually super pumped to help get things 
ready.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Cafe was grinding coffee beans, and 
Tachyon was literally mixing glowing 
liquids!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Wah♪ Cafe-chan's coffee, and 
Tachyon-chan's glowing liquid—wait, 
glowing liquid!?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it was all glittering pink and 
green!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I seeeeee... Well, I'm sure this is just 
Tachyon-chan's way of doing her best for 
us, yep!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heh, of course I put my all into getting 
ready too. Here's your present...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Mega-Huge Mt. Chomolungma Bucket Pudding! 
You said you wished it actually existed, 
right? Well, I asked Tachyon and she 
somehow whipped it up!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
'Course, you can have it all to yourself, 
Dants. It's your birthday, after all.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Havin' a humongous Mt. Everest dessert 
all to myself in real life... might 
seriously destroy my stomach...!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Still, Pokke-chan... She actually 
remembered something I just said 
offhandedly—)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... I'll be sure to eat every 
single bite! Along with Cafe-chan's 
coffee...!
